obligations.statement: The pedal must transmit a signal to the machine upon pressing.
derivation_premises: Pressing by foot must result in a signal."

obligations.statement: The pedal must return to its resting position automatically upon release of foot force.
derivation_premises: Self-return is required; likely requires stored energy or spring."

obligations.statement: The pedal must not move when a lateral (sideways) force is applied.
derivation_premises: Sideways brush must not cause displacement or activation."

obligations.statement: The pedal must allow foot operation and be reachable by the foot.
derivation_premises: Foot must be able to press and release the pedal."

obligations.statement: The pedal must be stable against lateral forces without unintended motion.
derivation_premises: Lateral force should not initiate motion."

obligations.statement: The pedal must return to its resting position after each use without manual assistance.
derivation_premises: Automatic return required; likely uses a spring or gravity."

obligations.statement: The mechanism must ensure that the pedal does not move under lateral forces (i.e., it must have lateral stability).
derivation_premises: Lateral forces should not cause displacement; implies a constraint on the mechanism."

obligations.statement: The pedal must be operable by foot pressure (i.e., it must be able to be pressed).
derivation_premises: Assumption ASM-0001: operated by foot pressure."

obligations.statement: The signal must be sent to the machine upon pressing (interface requirement).
derivation_premises: The signal is sent to the machine."

candidates.summary: A pedal that uses a revolute pair for rotation and a spring for return.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Basic mechanism, but lateral stability may require extra constraints.

candidates.summary: A pedal that uses a prismatic pair for linear motion and a spring for return.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Linear motion may be less stable laterally unless guided.

candidates.summary: A pedal that uses a compliant flexure for motion and a spring for return.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Lateral stiffness may be inherent, but analysis requires finite element.

candidates.summary: A pedal that uses a helical pair (screw) and a spring for return.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Rotary to linear, may have self-locking feature, but lateral stability needs analysis.
